values.roles.assignment: the path's layer directory (core, usecases, adapters, http) inside src/<context>/; a file with no layer directory is out of scope
values.idiom.auth_guard: wrap the handler with withCustomer(sessions, handler) from src/server/auth.ts: it answers 401 when the request has no valid session and passes the signed-in customer to the handler
values.idiom.route_handler: router.add(METHOD, pattern, handler) inside src/<context>/http/*-routes.ts; a handler returns { status, body }
values.idiom.error_types: domain functions throw an Error subclass defined in core (for example OrderStateError); the http layer maps it to a client-error response
values.idiom.external_import: relative imports with the .ts extension; there are no third-party packages

idiom.security.authorization_check: compare the resource's customerId with customer.id; answer 404 when it belongs to someone else

idiom.module_boundaries.internal_import: relative path with .ts extension, for example ../core/order.ts
